---
title: "Analog Design Notes"
toc: false
---

Learn how current and voltage behavior lead to an analog design choice.
Follow one transistor into a common-source amplifier, a finite mirror, a
differential OTA and feedback, then ask what uncertainty and power-up demand
change the decision.

## Start the connected learning route

[**Read the entry page and eight chapters**](learn/index.qmd) ·
[日本語の読み方](ja/learning-path.qmd)

**Learning edition v1.1 · 2026-09-13.** Original explanations connect first
predictions with selected saved observations and finite design costs. Basic
KCL/KVL is introduced at the entry; no simulator installation is needed to read.

New in this increment: work from required current and gm to actual supported
dimensions; see how mirror accuracy depends on output voltage; compare the
same initial OTA at 5/25 pF and explain its unchanged DC error and slower response.

| Follow the circuit | Make the next judgment |
| --- | --- |
| [1. MOS operating point and sizing](learn/01-mos-operating-point.qmd) | Current, local derivatives, headroom and dimensions. |
| [2. Common-source amplifier](learn/02-common-source.qmd) | Solve MOS behavior and load KCL together; compare R37/R75. |
| [3. Mirrors and bias](learn/03-mirrors-and-bias.qmd) | Count the reference before judging an active load. |
| [4. Differential pair and OTA](learn/04-differential-pair-and-ota.qmd) | Move from current steering to a finite low-voltage buffer. |
| [5. Feedback and response](learn/05-feedback-and-response.qmd) | Read connection/precision first, frequency/time response second. |
| [6. Errors and resources](learn/06-errors-and-resources.qmd) | Separate a source of error from its transmission. |
| [7. Supply and startup](learn/07-supply-and-startup.qmd) | Specify input and supply delivery/absorption through a history. |
| [8. Toward an LDO](learn/08-toward-an-ldo.qmd) | Identify receiving-port requirements and the evidence still needed. |

The [learning reproduction package](studies/learning-path-v1/reproduce.qmd)
contains selected differential-pair/OTA inputs, calculations and eight graph
examples. The new [learning-day supplement](studies/learning-day-v1/reproduce.qmd)
adds the sizing/mirror observations, separately planned receiving-port example,
five new graphs and a small native 25-pF replay. All six earlier ZIPs are retained.

## Detailed studies {#detailed-studies}

Each study keeps its original guide, exact circuits, measurement definitions,
failed attempts or physical requirements, results and versioned reproduction.
Their completed cohorts are known evidence for this edition.

| Study | Retained design lesson | Reproduction |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Gain, current balance and untrimmed accuracy](studies/gain-operating-point-accuracy/index.qmd) | Spending current in the signal branch differs from enlarging only the active reference. | [First study v1.0](studies/gain-operating-point-accuracy/reproduce.qmd) |
| [Passive sensitivity](studies/passive-sensitivity/index.qmd) | Common resistance shifts and ratio error can favor different designs. | [Passive v1.0](studies/passive-sensitivity/reproduce.qmd) |
| [Active-area allocation](studies/active-allocation/index.qmd) | Extra area helps most at the dominant error source; supply shifts can leave comparisons inconclusive. | [Allocation v1.0](studies/active-allocation/reproduce.qmd) |
| [Finite feedback](studies/finite-feedback/index.qmd) | Lower distortion and current-error transmission cost input drive, resistance and noise. | [Feedback v1.0](studies/finite-feedback/reproduce.qmd) |
| [Power sequencing](studies/power-sequencing/index.qmd) | A nominal current budget does not specify charging peaks or an input source's absorption. | [Sequencing v1.0](studies/power-sequencing/reproduce.qmd) |

The five study tags and exact old ZIP bytes are retained. The new learning
package has a separate identity. [Methods, model scope and review roles](methods.qmd)
explain what the numerical checks establish. These are pinned-model studies,
not manufacturing-yield or silicon qualifications. LDO design remains a
longer-term direction; this edition makes its missing interfaces explicit.
